Heavy Rain Triggers Red Alert and Waterlogging in Delhi-NCR

Heavy rain fell across Delhi-NCR, causing waterlogging in several areas. The India Meteorological Department issued a red alert for the region. In Delhi's Karol Bagh, the streets are reported as dilapidated and waterlogged. Over 200 families in Karol Bagh reported difficulties due to the flooding. Authorities have not yet announced specific relief measures.
